cards.name: youtube-character-limits-at
cards.title: YouTube character limits at a glance

groups.label: Video title
groups.text: YouTube won't let you save a title longer than 100 characters.

groups.label: Description
groups.text: The description field takes up to 5,000 characters.

groups.label: Tags
groups.text: Tags have one shared budget of 500 characters across all of them.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to Use the YouTube Character Counter

steps.title: Privacy
steps.text: The counter runs in your browser.

cards.name: best-practices
cards.title: Best Practices for YouTube Titles, Descriptions and Tags

cards.name: key-point
cards.kicker: Why You Need a YouTube Character Counter
cards.quote: YouTube Studio does show a counter while you type, but only in the field you're typing in, and only once you're already in the upload flow.
